subtitle: Crossing of 6 September 2026, confirmed reading of 06/Sep, 13:53 BRT (16:53 UTC) across the five books, with the presidential one at USD 144.11M. Most recent national poll: Veritá of 06/Sep, registration BR-09426/2026 at the TSE, fieldwork from 01 to 04/Sep. In this round all five books confirmed across the two readings.

candidates.name: Lula
candidates.header: PRICE: 56.50% (vol USD 9.83M accumulated) in the winner contract, confirmed reading of 06/Sep, 13:53 BRT, a rise of 1.00pp against the confirmed reading of 04/Sep. In the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) runner-up contract he rose 2.55pp to 7.90% (vol USD 474 thousand). POLL: Veritá of 06/Sep (BR-09426/2026, fieldwork 01 to 04/Sep, n=3,804, margin of 2pp) measures him at 38.4% in the first round, behind Flávio Bolsonaro by 0.5 point. The survey carries no [runoff](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) scenario.
fortes: He rose 1.00pp in the winner contract and widened the gap to the runner-up, which goes from 15.35pp to 16.80pp since the confirmed reading of 04/Sep.
⭐ THE PRICE WIDENED THE GAP ON THE VERY DAY THE POLL CLOSED IT, and the two measurements rank the race in opposite ways.
In the series recorded since 14/Apr his contract runs from 34.50% to 67.50%, and today's 56.50% sits inside that range, 12.00pp below the high of 16/Aug.
The most recent runoff reading is still Datafolha of 03/Sep, which has him beating the four pairings it tested, and the Veritá poll of today tested none.
Accumulated volume in his contract reached USD 9.83M, and the presidential book as a whole stands at USD 144.11M.
fracos: ⚠️ VERITÁ OF 06/Sep PUTS HIM BEHIND FOR THE FIRST TIME IN A ROUND BY THIS HOUSE: on 21/Aug the same Veritá gave him 39.3% against 39.1%, and now it is 38.4% against 38.9%.
It is the second national poll of the window to place Flávio Bolsonaro numerically ahead in the first round, after Gerp of 26/Aug, which gave 38% to 37%.
The distance of 0.5 point sits inside the margin of 2 points declared by Veritá, so the poll measures a statistical tie and not a lead for his opponent.
Veritá has a reliability of 2 on the house scale, the lowest among the institutes in the window, and it is not data to be read on its own.
Government disapproval in the Datafolha of 03/Sep is 51% against 45% approval, and the Veritá poll of today released no government rating.
candidates.analise: 6 September is the day on which the two measurements on this page point in opposite directions, and that is what it records. The winner contract rose 1.00pp to 56.50% (vol USD 9.83M) and widened the gap to the runner-up from 15.35pp to 16.80pp. On the same day, Veritá released the first national poll after two days without any and measured 38.4% for him against 38.9% for his opponent, a distance of 0.5 point inside a margin of 2 points. 📌 They are different quantities: the poll measures declared voting intention in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) and the contract measures the probability of winning the election, and they do not subtract from one another. The AFOS does not arbitrate which is right; it records that today they disagree on the ranking and that the price moved without the poll following it.

candidates.analise: His day has one strong number and a price that did not follow it. Veritá of 06/Sep, with fieldwork from 01 to 04/Sep and 3,804 interviews, measures him at 38.9% against 38.4% for the leader, and it is the second national poll of the window to place him numerically ahead in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). ⚠️ The distance of 0.5 point fits entirely inside the declared margin of 2 points, so the correct reading is a statistical tie. cruzamento: 6 September is the day on which the two measurements on this page point in opposite directions, and recording that is its purpose. ⭐ THE NATIONAL POLLING DROUGHT ENDED ON THE THIRD DAY: Veritá released a national poll with fieldwork from 01 to 04/Sep, registration BR-09426/2026 at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), 3,804 interviews and a margin of 2 points, and it puts Flávio Bolsonaro at 38.9% against 38.4% for Lula in the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno). ⚠️ The distance of 0.5 point fits entirely inside the declared margin, so what the poll measures is a statistical tie, not a lead. It is the second national poll of the window to bring the runner-up numerically ahead, after Gerp of 26/Aug, which gave 38% to 37%, and Veritá has a reliability of 2 on the house scale. ⭐ ON THE SAME DAY THE MARKET MOVED THE OTHER WAY: with all five books confirmed across the two readings, the winner contract gave 56.50% to Lula and 39.70% to Flávio Bolsonaro, and the gap went from 15.35pp on the confirmed reading of 04/Sep to 16.80pp. 📌 The two quantities do not subtract from one another. The poll measures declared voting intention in the first round and the contract measures the probability of winning the election, and a candidate can lead the first and not the second. The AFOS does not say which of the two is right. ⭐ THE NAME THAT RISES IN BOTH UNIVERSES IS AUGUSTO CURY: Veritá measures him at 12.2%, against 2.2% in the same house's round on 21/Aug, and the first-round third-place contract rose 4.25pp to 56.20%. In the winner contract, however, he gave up 0.80pp to 1.15%, which is coherent: the market is consolidating him as the third-placed finisher of the first round and not as a candidate to win the election. 📌 At the Supreme Court the record is one of decoupling. On 05/Sep the case produced two new institutional acts, a proposed amendment to the internal rules filed by Gilmar Mendes and a request for accountability made by Cristiano Zanin over a breach of tax secrecy, and the contract on impeachment before 2027 stayed all but still, at 8.60% against 8.65% the day before. On 06/Sep, a Sunday, there is no new institutional act. The TSE calendar carries another ten national polls with releases scheduled between 07 and 11/Sep, among them Quaest, Nexus, AtlasIntel and Datafolha, and there are 28 days to the first round.
